Four files use `resolveBoardScope`. I searched the whole repo, excluding `node_modules`, `.git` and `.next`, and none of the matches were in test files.

- `web/src/app/api/v1/board/route.ts` imports it and calls it at line 57: `resolveBoardScope(query.community, callerUserId)`.
- `web/src/app/api/og/community/[slug]/route.tsx` imports it and calls it at line 103: `resolveBoardScope(slug, null)`.
- `web/src/app/community/[slug]/page.tsx` imports it and calls it at line 45.
- `web/src/lib/leaderboard/resolve-scope.ts` defines it (line 14). I've listed it because it's the definition, not a caller.

`web/src/app/global/page.tsx` only mentions the function in a comment and doesn't call it, so I left it out.

web/src/app/api/v1/board/route.ts
web/src/app/api/og/community/[slug]/route.tsx
web/src/app/community/[slug]/page.tsx
web/src/lib/leaderboard/resolve-scope.ts
</files>
